#include<iostream> #include<string> #include<cstdio> using namespace std;

string sk; string s; int l[22000010]; int n;

int main(){ cin>>sk; s+=(''); for(int i=0;i<sk.size();i++){ s+=(sk[i]); s+=(''); } int mr=0,mri=0; for(int i=1;i<s.size();i++){ if(i<=mr)l[i]=min(mr-i+1,l[2*mri-i]); while(l[i]+i<s.size()&&i-l[i]>=0&&s[l[i]+i]==s[i-l[i]])l[i]++; if(i+l[i]>mr)mr=i+l[i]-1,mri=i; } int ans=0; for(int i=0;i<s.size();i++){//l[i]为回文半径，l[i]-1为真实回文长度 ans=max(l[i]-1,ans); } printf("%d",ans); return 0; }
